productionSource: IdleArc official atlas already indexed in fytchx/Arcana
permission: User states IdleArc developer Mik granted permission to use game art
validation: All source category:key IDs exist in checked source manifest. Visual selection and sign-off are still required.

targets.label: Torch / utility
targets.emphasis: Real torch bowl, handle and flame silhouette; not a potion flask.

targets.label: Head
targets.emphasis: Recognizable helmet/hood silhouette, with a single crown or face opening.

targets.label: Necklace
targets.emphasis: Pendant with its actual hanging chain and stone outline.

targets.label: Main hand
targets.emphasis: Default weapon shape should be neutral; when an item is equipped, reflect its actual type (blade/bow/wand).
targets.usage: Main-hand gear slot and legal item picker
targets.note: Do not depict all weapons as swords.

targets.label: Chest
targets.emphasis: Clear torso/shoulder armor form, broad silhouette and narrow waist.

targets.label: Off hand
targets.emphasis: Select shield/book/quiver silhouette from actual equipped off-hand type; no fixed shield for everyone.
targets.note: Type-dependent once an item is selected.

targets.label: Ring I
targets.emphasis: Jewelry ring with readable inner aperture and setting; small UI numeral I outside source artwork.

targets.label: Belt
targets.emphasis: Broad belt with an obvious central buckle.

targets.label: Ring II
targets.emphasis: Same recognizable game-inspired ring shape as Ring I; optional numeral II in UI chrome.
targets.note: Avoid a fake second ring type.

targets.label: Utility I
targets.emphasis: A simple utility pouch/relic holder, not a made-up equipable talisman.
targets.note: Source motif, not proof a satchel is equippable in this slot.

targets.label: Hands
targets.emphasis: Actual glove/gauntlet outline with articulated fingers.

targets.label: Feet
targets.emphasis: Recognizable game boot profile rather than abstract geometric feet.

targets.label: Utility II
targets.emphasis: Same neutral utility motif as Utility I; differentiate only with slot position/UI label.
targets.note: Do not imply a nonexistent distinct item category.

targets.label: Warrior
targets.emphasis: Physical defensive melee identity informed by real class skill silhouettes.
targets.note: Confirm motif from source atlas visually.

targets.label: Archer
targets.emphasis: Bow/string or aiming silhouette; leave out unrelated wings or helmets.

targets.label: Mage
targets.emphasis: Orb or magic focus shape matching actual Mage skill and wand design.

targets.label: Rogue
targets.emphasis: Recognizable paired blades/dagger form, sharper and narrower than Warrior.

targets.label: Druid
targets.emphasis: Organic/nature bond motif informed by actual Druid skills, not generic leaf logo.

targets.label: Build Studio
targets.emphasis: Loadout frame + recognizable rune core. Distinguished from ordinary Builds link.

targets.label: Wiki
targets.emphasis: Open reference book: readable spreads and a plain page edge.

targets.label: Tools
targets.emphasis: Functional forge core + measured/calculation mark, not a generic keyboard calculator.

targets.label: Guides
targets.emphasis: Bookmarked manual with an unmistakable guide marker; separate from Wiki book.

targets.label: Builds
targets.emphasis: Saved equipment preset stack, not identical to Build Studio flagship sigil.

targets.label: Codex
targets.emphasis: Indexed inventory archive: small item specimen over a catalog outline.

targets.label: Guild & Raid Finder
targets.emphasis: Actual Guildstone crest and compact raid-party outline; avoid fake class symbols.

targets.label: Rune Forge
targets.emphasis: Preserve the in-game rune stone/cut and recognizable core silhouette.

targets.label: Class Skills
targets.emphasis: Skill icon framing and branch marker inspired by actual skill artwork.

targets.label: Passive Tree
targets.emphasis: Connect passive-point glyphs with simple node paths; no random constellation.

targets.label: Pet Lab
targets.emphasis: Pet egg silhouette plus recognizable pet motif, no generic paw as sole symbol.

targets.label: Upgrade Calculator
targets.emphasis: Forge/catalyst + incremental progression mark.

targets.label: Arcstone
targets.emphasis: Keep the recognizable official Arcstone art and native hues.

targets.label: Ruby
targets.emphasis: Keep the official ruby token exactly recognizable.

targets.label: Gold
targets.emphasis: Keep the official coin symbol and color identity.

targets.label: Guildstone
targets.emphasis: Use the game's Guildstone design, not a generic gem.

targets.label: Pet Egg
targets.emphasis: Official egg icon. Avoid replacing with a standard Easter egg silhouette.

targets.label: Pet Shard
targets.emphasis: Official shard token, preserve native color.

targets.label: Rune Dust
targets.emphasis: Official dust token.

targets.label: Rune Reforge
targets.emphasis: Official rune reforge token.

targets.label: Runic Core
targets.emphasis: Official runic core shape.

targets.label: Upgrade Catalyst
targets.emphasis: Keep precise catalyst artwork, not a generic sparkle.

targets.label: Gem
targets.emphasis: Game gem cuts and original colors; do not recolor game item art to user accent.

targets.label: Gem Dust
targets.emphasis: Official gem dust artwork.

targets.label: Attack Damage
targets.emphasis: Weapon stroke with weight, not an arbitrary polygon.

targets.label: Flat Damage
targets.emphasis: Solid strike mark separate from proportional attack icon.

targets.label: Crit Chance
targets.emphasis: Precision/target focal point, distinguish from Crit Damage.

targets.label: Crit Damage
targets.emphasis: Burst strike fragment, stronger shape than Crit Chance.

targets.label: Defense
targets.emphasis: Protective plate/block silhouette, avoid identical Block Chance mark.

targets.label: Block Chance
targets.emphasis: Parry/deflection angle, differentiable from static defense.

targets.label: Retaliation
targets.emphasis: Damage redirected outward from armor. Verify against in-game mechanic language.
targets.note: Source is thematic inspiration only, not an official retaliation icon.

targets.label: Pet Damage
targets.emphasis: Pet silhouette plus controlled offensive mark.

targets.label: Strength
targets.emphasis: Heavy-lift grip shape, not generic bicep.

targets.label: Dexterity
targets.emphasis: Precise bow or quick draw.

targets.label: Intelligence
targets.emphasis: Arcane focus central glyph.

targets.label: Gold Gain
targets.emphasis: Official gold token with small plus/arrow UI mark.

targets.label: EXP Gain
targets.emphasis: Clear upward progression motif, not a claimed official EXP sprite.
targets.note: No confirmed EXP-specific sprite in official manifest.

targets.label: Drop Bonus
targets.emphasis: Loot highlight and item outline.

targets.label: Extra Kill
targets.emphasis: Second target/kill indicator with a concise split stroke.

targets.label: Boss Damage
targets.emphasis: Boss crown/face outline with impact mark; do not copy boss portrait into tiny stat tile.

targets.label: All Class Skills
targets.emphasis: Neutral multi-class signifier, not a Mage-specific token.

targets.label: Armor
targets.emphasis: Defensive chest material, separate from block icon.
